column1: # Incidents: part lost, low power, signal lost and back, crew lost (plan v4 features 6, 7, 8, 10). New keys: in_

column15: english
Is that thing drifting away ours? | Is that thing drifting away ours? | Hey, is that piece floating off one of ours?

column14: Parece que sí. No pasa nada, seguid.
column15: Looks like it. No problem, carry on. | Looks like it. No problem, carry on. | Probably. Not a problem. Continue.

column14: Algo pequeño se ha soltado. Nada grave.
column15: Something small came loose. Nothing serious. | Something small came loose. Nothing serious. | A small bit came off. Nothing big.

column14: Recibido. Lo vemos en los datos.
column15: Copy. We see it in the data. | Copy. We see it in the data. | Copy. It shows in the data.

column14: Se ha caído una pieza. Creo que no la necesitábamos.
column15: A part fell off. I don't think we needed it. | A part fell off. I don't think we needed it. | Something fell off. Hopefully something extra.
Let's hope not. Noted. | Let's hope not. Noted. | Fingers crossed. Logged.

column14: Algo explotó ahí fuera, pero era pequeño.
column15: Something blew up out there, but it was small. | Something blew up out there, but it was small. | Small explosion outside. Just a little one.
Copy. All good inside? | Copy. All good inside? | Copy. Inside okay?
All good inside. | All good inside. | Inside is fine.
Something blew up! We lost a part! | Something blew up! We lost a part! | Explosion! A part is gone!
Boom! What broke? | Boom! What broke? | Boom! What was that?

column14: Eso no era un ruido normal. Falta una pieza.
column15: That wasn't a normal noise. A part is missing. | That wasn't a normal noise. A part is missing. | Strange noise. Something is missing now.
Something broke off the hull! | Something broke off the hull! | A piece came off the hull!
Control, something blew up outside. | Control, something blew up outside. | Control, explosion outside.
Copy. Check your systems. | Copy. Check your systems. | Copy. Systems check.

column14: Hemos perdido una pieza. Seguimos de una pieza... casi.
column15: We lost a part. We're still in one piece... mostly. | We lost a part. We're still in one piece... mostly. | A part is gone. The rest is still here... mostly.
Copy. Give us a report. | Copy. Give us a report. | Copy. Report, please.
Minor damage. Still flying. | Minor damage. Still flying. | Small damage. We fly on.
Explosion outside! We're still here. | Explosion outside! We're still here. | Something blew up! We're still here.
We see you. Keep control. | We see you. Keep control. | We have you. Stay in control.
That hit tore something off. | That hit tore something off. | That hit ripped something off.
Copy. How much damage? | Copy. How much damage? | Copy. Damage report?
Hard to say. We're still in one piece. | Hard to say. We're still in one piece. | Not sure. Still in one piece.
Everything's exploding! It's falling apart! | Everything's exploding! It's falling apart! | It's all exploding! Pieces everywhere!
Boom, boom, boom! Make it stop! | Boom, boom, boom! Make it stop! | Boom! Boom! Stop it!
We're losing parts! Lots of parts! | We're losing parts! Lots of parts! | Parts are flying off! So many!
Another one blew up! Control, help! | Another one blew up! Control, help! | One more exploded! Help, Control!
There's barely any ship left! Do something! | There's barely any ship left! Do something! | Almost no ship left! Help!
Explosions everywhere! Hold on tight! | Explosions everywhere! Hold on tight! | Boom everywhere! Hang on!
Copy, we saw that. Keep us posted. | Copy, we saw that. Keep us posted. | We saw it. Keep us updated.

column14: Control aquí. Hemos perdido los datos de una pieza.
column15: Control here. We lost the data from a part. | Control here. We lost the data from a part. | Control here. One part stopped sending data.
Breathe. Tell us what still works. | Breathe. Tell us what still works. | Breathe. What still works?

column14: Vimos la explosión. Calma ahí arriba.
column15: We saw the explosion. Stay calm up there. | We saw the explosion. Stay calm up there. | Explosion seen. Calm, {vessel}.

column14: Recibido. Comprobad la presión de la cabina.
column15: Copy. Check the cabin pressure. | Copy. Check the cabin pressure. | Copy. Cabin pressure check.

column14: Entendido. Olvidad la pieza y pilotad la nave.
column15: Understood. Forget the part and fly the ship. | Understood. Forget the part and fly the ship. | Copy. Forget the part. Fly {vessel}.

column14: La batería está casi vacía. Apago lo que sobra.
column15: The battery is almost empty. Shutting off what we don't need. | The battery is almost empty. Shutting off what we don't need. | Battery nearly empty. Switching off extras.
Copy. Good idea. | Copy. Good idea. | Copy. Smart.

column14: Desplegad los paneles solares, si los tenemos.
column15: Deploy the solar panels, if we have any. | Deploy the solar panels, if we have any. | Solar panels out, if we have them. | [solar] Get the solar panels out.
Copy. We're watching the charge. | Copy. We're watching the charge. | Copy. Watching the battery.

column14: Queda poca carga. Apago todo menos la radio.
column15: Charge is low. Shutting down everything but the radio. | Charge is low. Shutting down everything but the radio. | Low charge. Only the radio stays on.
Good thinking. We need to hear you. | Good thinking. We need to hear you. | Good. We need to hear you.

column14: Las luces se apagan poco a poco.
column15: The lights are slowly dimming. | The lights are slowly dimming. | The lights are fading.
It's the battery. Save power. | It's the battery. Save power. | Battery. Save what you can.

column14: La pantalla parpadea. Eso no es buena señal.
column15: The screen is flickering. That's not a good sign. | The screen is flickering. That's not a good sign. | Flickering screen. Not good.

column14: Carga baja. Apagad lo que no uséis.
column15: Low charge. Shut down what you're not using. | Low charge. Shut down what you're not using. | Low battery. Switch off what you don't use.
Who left the lights on? | Who left the lights on? | Who forgot to turn off the lights?

column14: Batería baja. Esto ya no es broma.
column15: Battery low. This is no joke now. | Battery low. This is no joke now. | Low battery. Not funny anymore.
The lights are back! | The lights are back! | Lights on again!
Copy. Charge is rising. | Copy. Charge is rising. | Copy. Charge going up.
The battery is recovering. | The battery is recovering. | Battery is coming back.

column14: Bien. Ya podéis encender la cafetera.
column15: Good. You can turn the coffee maker back on. | Good. You can turn the coffee maker back on. | Good. You can reheat the {food} again.
column16: Bien. Ya podéis encender la cafetera. | Bien. Ya podéis encender la cafetera. | Bien. Ya podéis volver a calentar {el food}.

column15: Power is stable again. | Power is stable again. | Stable power again.
Perfect. We see it here too. | Perfect. We see it here too. | Great. We see it too.
Control? Is anyone there? | Control? Is anyone there? | Control? Anybody?
We've lost the signal. | We've lost the signal. | Signal is gone.

column14: La radio no contesta. Nadie nos oye.
column15: The radio is silent. Nobody can hear us. | The radio is silent. Nobody can hear us. | Radio silence. Nobody hears us.

column14: Sin conexión con Control. Seguimos por nuestra cuenta.
column15: No link with Control. We're on our own. | No link with Control. We're on our own. | No link. On our own now.

column14: Solo hay ruido en la radio.
column15: There's only static on the radio. | There's only static on the radio. | Just static.

column14: Control, si nos oís, todo va bien... creo.
column15: Control, if you can hear us, all is well... I think. | Control, if you can hear us, all is well... I think. | Control, if you hear this, we're okay... probably.

column14: Ya no hay señal. Qué silencio.
column15: No signal anymore. So quiet. | No signal anymore. So quiet. | No signal. Very quiet.
We'll have to decide without help. | We'll have to decide without help. | We decide on our own now.
Control? ...Control? | Control? ...Control? | Control? Hello? Control?
No answer. We'll have to wait. | No answer. We'll have to wait. | Nothing. We wait.
Can anyone else hear Control? | Can anyone else hear Control? | Does anyone else hear Control?
No. Nothing at all. | No. Nothing at all. | No. Nothing.
The signal is gone. | The signal is gone. | No more signal.
Then we're in charge now. | Then we're in charge now. | So we're the bosses now.
Control? Can you hear us now? | Control? Can you hear us now? | Control? Hear us now?
Yes. We have you again. | Yes. We have you again. | Yes. You're back.
The signal is back! | The signal is back! | Signal again!

column14: Recibido. Os oímos alto y claro.
column15: Copy. We hear you loud and clear. | Copy. We hear you loud and clear. | Copy. Loud and clear.
Control, did you miss us? | Control, did you miss us? | Control, missed us?
A little. Well, a lot. | A little. Well, a lot. | A bit. Okay, a lot.
We have a link again. | We have a link again. | Link restored.
Finally. What did we miss? | Finally. What did we miss? | At last. Anything new?
Nothing. Well, almost nothing. | Nothing. Well, almost nothing. | Nothing. Mostly nothing.
Ship here. Are you still there? | Ship here. Are you still there? | {vessel} here. Still there?
Always. We never left. | Always. We never left. | Always here.
The radio works again. | The radio works again. | Radio is working again.
Copy. Telemetry is back. | Copy. Telemetry is back. | Copy. Telemetry again.

column14: Control a la nave. Hemos perdido a un miembro de la tripulación.
column15: Control to ship. We have lost a crew member. | Control to ship. We have lost a crew member. | Control here. We lost a member of the crew.

column14: Lo sentimos mucho. Siempre formará parte de esta misión.
column15: We are very sorry. They will always be part of this mission. | We are very sorry. They will always be part of this mission. | We are so sorry. They will always belong to this mission.

column14: Un momento de silencio en la radio, por favor.
column15: A moment of radio silence, please. | A moment of radio silence, please. | Let's have a moment of silence.

column14: Hoy hemos perdido a alguien. Seguid con cuidado.
column15: We lost someone today. Carry on carefully. | We lost someone today. Carry on carefully. | Someone is gone today. Go on carefully.

column14: Confirmado. No hay respuesta. Lo sentimos.
column15: Confirmed. There is no response. We are sorry. | Confirmed. There is no response. We are sorry. | Confirmed. No response. We're sorry.

column14: Mantened la calma. Traed al resto a casa.
column15: Stay calm. Bring the others home. | Stay calm. Bring the others home. | Stay calm. Bring the rest home.

column14: Hemos perdido a alguien. No hay palabras.
column15: We lost someone. There are no words. | We lost someone. There are no words. | Someone is gone. I have no words.

column14: Control, se ha ido. No pudimos hacer nada.
column15: Control, they're gone. There was nothing we could do. | Control, they're gone. There was nothing we could do. | Control, they're gone. We couldn't help.

column14: Seguiremos adelante. Por quien no vuelve.
column15: We'll carry on. For the one who won't come back. | We'll carry on. For the one who won't come back. | We go on. For the one who stays behind.
